Question:
Considering only the customers who placed orders in 1998, calculate the total amount each customer spent by summing the unit price multiplied by the quantity of all products in their orders, excluding any discounts. Assign each customer to a spending group based on the customer group thresholds, and determine how many customers are in each spending group and what percentage of the total number of customers who placed orders in 1998 each group represents.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT o.customerid, SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) as total_spent
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
    WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o.orderdate <= '1998-12-31'
    GROUP BY o.customerid
),
customer_with_group AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.customerid,
        cs.total_spent,
        CASE 
            WHEN cs.total_spent >= 10000 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN cs.total_spent >= 5000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN cs.total_spent >= 1000 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END as spending_group
    FROM customer_spending cs
)
SELECT 
    spending_group,
    COUNT(*) as customer_count,
    1.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_with_group) * 100 as percentage
FROM customer_with_group
GROUP BY spending_group
ORDER BY spending_group

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT o.customerid, SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) as total_spent,
           CASE 
             WHEN SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) BETWEEN 0 AND 999.9999 THEN 'Low'
             WHEN SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) BETWEEN 1000 AND 4999.9999 THEN 'Medium'
             WHEN SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) BETWEEN 5000 AND 9999.9999 THEN 'High'
             WHEN SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) >= 10000 THEN 'Very High'
           END as spending_group
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.orderdate) = 1998
    GROUP BY o.customerid
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT spending_group, COUNT(*) as customer_count
    FROM customer_spending
    GROUP BY spending_group
),
total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT gc.spending_group, 
       gc.customer_count,
       tc.total_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * gc.customer_count / tc.total_count, 2) as percentage
FROM group_counts gc
CROSS JOIN total_customers tc
ORDER BY gc.customer_count DESC

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT o.customerid, SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) as total_spent
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
    WHERE strftime('%Y', o.orderdate) = '1998'
    GROUP BY o.customerid
),
customer_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        customerid,
        total_spent,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_spent < 1000 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN total_spent < 5000 THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN total_spent < 10000 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Very High'
        END as spending_group
    FROM customer_spending
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT spending_group, COUNT(*) as customer_count
    FROM customer_groups
    GROUP BY spending_group
),
total_customer_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_customers
    FROM customer_groups
)
SELECT 
    gc.spending_group,
    gc.customer_count,
    100.0 * gc.customer_count / tcc.total_customers as percentage
FROM group_counts gc
CROSS JOIN total_customer_count tcc
ORDER BY gc.spending_group
